shortDescription: Manage pfSense IPsec tunnels and phase 1 options

options.name: apply
options.description: Apply VPN configuration on target pfSense

options.name: authentication_method
options.description: Authenticatin method. Must match the setting chosen on the remote side.

options.name: certificate
options.description: a certificate previously configured

options.name: certificate_authority
options.description: a certificate authority previously configured

options.name: closeaction
options.description: Set this option to control the behavior when the remote peer unexpectedly closes a child SA (P2).  New in pfSense 2.5.2.

options.name: descr
options.description: The description of the IPsec tunnel

options.name: disable_reauth
options.description: (IKEv2 only) Whether rekeying of an IKE_SA should also reauthenticate the peer. In IKEv1, reauthentication is always done.

options.name: disable_rekey
options.description: Disables renegotiation when a connection is about to expire (deprecated with pfSense 2.5.0)

options.name: disabled
options.description: Set this option to disable this phase1 without removing it from the list.

options.name: dpd_delay
options.description: Delay between requesting peer acknowledgement.

options.name: dpd_maxfail
options.description: Number of consecutive failures allowed before disconnect.

options.name: enable_dpd
options.description: Enable dead peer detection

options.name: gw_duplicates
options.description: Allow multiple phase 1 configurations with the same endpoint

options.name: iketype
options.description: Internet Key Exchange protocol version to be used. Auto uses IKEv2 when initiator, and accepts either IKEv1 or IKEv2 as responder.

options.name: interface
options.description: Interface for the local endpoint of this phase1 entry.  Can be a virtual IP name or address prefixed with "vip:".

options.name: lifetime
options.description: The lifetime defines how often the connection will be rekeyed, in seconds.

options.name: margintime
options.description: How long before connection expiry or keying-channel expiry should attempt to negotiate a replacement begin (deprecated with pfSense 2.5.0)

options.name: mobike
options.description: (IKEv2 only) Set this option to control the use of MOBIKE

options.name: mode
options.description: Negotiation mode. Aggressive is more flexible, but less secure. Only for IkeV1 or Auto.

options.name: myid_data
options.description: Local identifier value.

options.name: myid_type
options.description: Local identifier type.

options.name: nat_traversal
options.description: Set this option to enable the use of NAT-T (i.e. the encapsulation of ESP in UDP packets) if needed, which can help with clients that are behind restrictive firewalls.

options.name: nattport
options.description: UDP port for NAT-T on the remote gateway.

options.name: peerid_data
options.description: Remote identifier value.

options.name: peerid_type
options.description: Remote identifier type.

options.name: preshared_key
options.description: This key must match on both peers.

options.name: protocol
options.description: IP family

options.name: rand_time
options.description: A random value up to this amount will be subtracted from Rekey Time/Reauth Time to avoid simultaneous renegotiation.

options.name: reauth_time
options.description: Time, in seconds, before an IKE SA is torn down and recreated from scratch, including authentication.

options.name: rekey_time
options.description: Time, in seconds, before an IKE SA establishes new keys.

options.name: remote_gateway
options.description: Public IP address or host name of the remote gateway.

options.name: responderonly
options.description: Enable this option to never initiate this connection from this side, only respond to incoming requests.  Removed in pfSense 2.5.2.

options.name: splitconn
options.description: (IKEv2 only) Enable this to split connection entries with multiple phase 2 configurations

options.name: startaction
options.description: Set this option to force specific initiation/responder behavior for child SA (P2) entries.  New in pfSense 2.5.2.

options.name: state
options.description: State in which to leave the IPsec tunnel
